title: 第十七章 秦天入圣第十八章 圣境老祖
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
领取奖励后，秦天进入一个玄妙境界，沉迷其中。
他感觉到体内在发生翻天覆地的变化。
同时脑海中也多了很多对圣境的感悟。
他化自在大法，提升到了十二重。
他也晋升为圣境强者了。
这其中除了系统的功劳外，还有他这五年自行修炼的功劳。
不然的话，五年的签到值也不足以让他突破。
还有万古不灭体的进阶，也是非常值得高兴的。
一重的万古不灭体都能挡下天阶极品武器攻击。
那么二重的万古不灭体，挡下帝阶下品武器的攻击，应该也是没问题的。
这一变化，足足持续了三个时辰。
就在秦天突破圣境的时候，东洲的虚空中出现了异象。
一道道金光透过云彩照射出来。
正在修炼的莫问天猛的起身震惊道：
“圣光耀世，这是有人突破到了圣境。”
希望这圣境不是出现在魔宗或者是妖族，不然东洲危以。
当秦天醒悟时。
发现白筱如和安妙菱正盯着他看。
“师傅好像又变强了。”安妙菱嘟哝道。
小狐狸白筱如也郁闷的点了点头，难道真的要等一百年才能解除契约吗！

“变强不好吗？”以后我照着你们。
随后秦天又做了一顿饭。
饭做好后，白筱如变回人身吃饭。
秦天在一次看呆了，安妙菱也被白筱如的容颜吸引到了。
她的那双媚眼可谓是男女通杀。
不过当她看到秦天的色眯眯的眼神时，表情有些不自然了。
自己竟然有点吃醋了！
我绝情女帝尽然会吃醋，她觉得有点难以置信。
“你在盯着我看，我就变回去了。”
白筱如也受不了秦天的眼神，被盯着有点害羞了。
秦天尴尬的笑了笑，便收回目光开始干饭。
吃完饭后。
秦天回到房间拿出了生死剑看了起来。
这可是至尊阶的剑。
之前用冰璃剑斩杀穆以寒附体的妖圣时，他就想着自己也要弄一把好兵器。
毕竟那些妖兽都是皮糙肉厚的。
他先是布下了阵法遮挡异象，然后开始认主。
认主后他发现剑中的两道意境，生之意境和死之意境。
content_en:
After receiving the reward, Qin Tian entered a mysterious realm and became addicted to it.
He felt earth-shaking changes taking place inside his body.
At the same time, there are many more insights into the holy realm in my mind.
He transformed the Dafa of Freedom into the twelfth level.
He has also been promoted to a strong man in the Holy Realm.
In addition to the credit for the system, there is also the credit for his self-cultivation in the past five years.
Otherwise, five years of signing value will not be enough for him to break through.
There is also the advancement of the Eternal Immortal Body, which is also very exciting.
A level one Eternal Immortal Body can block attacks from top-grade heaven-level weapons.
Then it should be no problem for the second-level Eternal Immortal Body to block attacks from lower-grade Emperor-level weapons.
This change lasted for three hours.
Just when Qin Tian broke through to the holy realm, a strange phenomenon appeared in the void of Dongzhou.
Rays of golden light shine through the clouds.
Mo Wentian, who was practicing, stood up suddenly and said in shock:
"The Holy Light shines on the world. This is someone who has broken through to the Holy Realm."
I hope this holy realm does not appear in the Demon Sect or the Demon Clan, otherwise Dongzhou will be in danger.
When Qin Tian woke up.
He found Bai Xiaoru and An Miaoling staring at him.
"Master seems to have become stronger again." An Miaoling muttered.
The little fox Bai Xiaoru also nodded depressedly. Do we really have to wait a hundred years to terminate the contract?
"Isn't it good to become stronger?" I will take care of you from now on.
Then Qin Tian cooked another meal.
After the meal is ready, Bai Xiaoru transforms into a human body and eats.
Qin Tian was stunned for once, and An Miaoling was also attracted by Bai Xiaoru's appearance.
Her charming eyes can be said to kill both men and women.
But when she saw Qin Tian's leering eyes, her expression became a little unnatural.
I'm actually a little jealous!
My ruthless empress would definitely be jealous, she found it a bit unbelievable.
"You were staring at me and I changed back."
Bai Xiaoru couldn't stand Qin Tian's eyes either, and felt a little shy being stared at.
Qin Tian smiled awkwardly, then looked away and started to cook.
After eating.
Qin Tian returned to the room and took out the Sword of Life and Death and read it.
This is a supreme level sword.
When he used the ice glass sword to kill the demon saint possessed by Mu Yihan, he thought that he would also get a good weapon.
After all, those monsters are rough-skinned and thick-flesh.
He first set up a formation to block the vision, and then began to recognize the master.
After recognizing the master, he discovered two artistic conceptions in the sword, the artistic conception of life and the artistic conception of death.
